title: Cummins Inc. says data-centre power demand 'remains robust' as Q2 sales hit record $9.5bn
description: A Motley Fool review of Cummins (published 10 Sep 2026) cites record Q2 2026 revenue of $9.5 billion, full-year growth guidance raised to 10-13%, and Power Systems sales up 19%. It notes the Circe Energy gas-genset deal and a US data-centre BESS selection.
quote: demand for data center power generation remains robust
analysis: Parent demand is strong, but it is led by US, China and Asia Pacific data centres, so large-genset slots compete with Gulf orders. Cummins Arabia should ask Cummins Power Systems for confirmed 2027 allocation on its pipeline of hyperscale sets.

title: Edarat wins SAR 197.8m award for 200MW AI data centre in Saudi Arabia (HUMAIN-MIS development)
description: Edarat received an award letter on 8 Sep 2026 from Al Moammar Information Systems for design, supervision and commissioning of a 200MW AI data centre. The wider HUMAIN-MIS development was raised from 50MW to 250MW and will be delivered in phases.
quote: The development is expected to be delivered in phases.
analysis: A 200MW to 250MW build creates a backup-power requirement of the scale Cummins Arabia already serves (73.2MW hyperscale case study, June 2025). The article names no generator supplier, so approach MIS and Edarat now before the power package is let.

title: Saudi Energy signs three AI data-centre power agreements (HUMAIN Riyadh, center3, Huawei); no MW disclosed
description: On 2 Sep 2026 Saudi Energy announced a grid-electricity agreement for HUMAIN's Riyadh AI data centre, a framework with center3 and an MoU with Huawei. The analysis notes a 14 GW government ambition and a 250MW HUMAIN-MIS build, with no connection dates or values.
quote: The announcements establish coordination, not energised capacity.
analysis: Grid agreements raise the number of sites that will need on-site standby sets, but nothing here is energised capacity or a named generator supplier. Track which of these projects reach power-package tender and map them to Cummins Arabia's Eastern and Central region sales coverage.

title: HUMAIN plans 250 MW online by end-2026 and a 1.7 GW Saudi data-centre build in 2027
description: HUMAIN CEO Tareq Amin said 250 MW comes online by end-2026 and 1.7 GW is built in 2027, rising to about 3 GW by 2030 and 6 GW by 2034. Typical AI data-centre cost is USD 10-12 million per MW.
quote: Almost 80% of my capital is going to the data centers,
analysis: A 1.7 GW build in 2027 is the largest identifiable Saudi demand driver for high-horsepower standby sets, and Cummins Arabia has no public HUMAIN supply deal in the sources checked. Confirm where HUMAIN's EPC and power-package awards stand and secure Cummins QSK78 and QSK60 allocation against them.

title: EquipmentShare and Cummins agree multi-year fleet deal targeting 1 GW of mobile gas power
description: Announced 29 Sep 2026, the agreement makes EquipmentShare a rental and distribution channel for Cummins gas gensets (C1400N6C, 60Hz), with fleet growth to 1 GW for temporary power, microgrid and BESS. The release is US-focused and does not mention the Middle East.
quote: expected fleet growth to 1 gigawatt of natural gas power generation capacity
analysis: It shows Cummins backing a gas-led rental model with large 60Hz units, a template for Saudi mega-project temporary power, where rental is the main route. Review whether Cummins Arabia's rental offering and gas-genset stock can match this, since the product here is 60Hz and the Gulf mostly uses 50Hz.

title: Analyst note: Cummins plans 55 GW capacity by 2030 on about $450m investment, flags data-centre delivery risk
description: A 2 Oct 2026 analysis cites Cummins' plan to add 20 GW for about $450 million, reaching 55 GW by 2030, and data-centre revenue near $5 billion in 2026 guidance. It also cites Goldman Sachs' estimate that 50% to 60% of near-term US data-centre capacity arrives on time.
analysis: More Cummins large-genset capacity eases supply for Gulf customers from 2027-28 but the first additions go to US hyperscalers. Plan Cummins Arabia's 2027 quotes on current lead times and re-check allocation after the Q3 results (estimated 3 Nov 2026, not confirmed).
